name: 15-minute dial-in checklist
hook: Your shots taste different every morning. It is rarely the beans.
bridge: Owners who find their dial-in gaps are the ones who want the first bag dialled in with them, which the subscription includes.
notes: Top survey theme (8 of 24, plus 2 more about espresso). Owner's own visit routine makes it first-hand.

name: Weekly bean order calculator
hook: Run out on Saturday or throw away stale bags? Order by numbers, not by guessing.
bridge: The calculator gives the weekly amount; the subscription delivers exactly that on a schedule.
notes: Second theme (6 of 24). Strongest bridge. Needs a small page with JavaScript, more build time.

name: Barista training routine
hook: Every new hire pulls shots differently.
bridge: Weak: training is not what the subscription sells.

name: The complete guide to coffee origins
hook: Everything about where coffee comes from.
bridge: Origins are on the bags, loosely related.
